purpose: Storage for the APD participant learning path (course progress card, PR 4a with the backfill merged in): access list learning_path_id column, writing it on enrollment, the scholarship package lookup query, and assigning a newly created learning path to already enrolled students of its scholarship package.
acceptance_criteria: access_lists.learning_path_id is nullable with a restrict foreign key to the campaign learning path
A student enrolling through the cohort form is stored with the learning path of their scholarship package
A student whose package has no learning path is stored with a null learning path
Creating a learning path with a scholarship package gives it to enrolled STUDENT rows of that campaign and package whose learning_path_id is null, in the same transaction
Students that already have a learning path and other roles are not changed; a learning path without a package assigns nobody
